item.title: Women's Circle: Finding the Still Point — Fri Sep 11, 6:30 PM — Yoga Mechanics
item.description:
Women’s Circle is a monthly gathering for women to come together in a supportive, intentional space. Each month centers on a new theme, offering time for reflection, connection, and shared growth. New participants are always welcome. We suggest bringing a journal and a small object that reflects the month’s theme. This might be a photo, token, or meaningful item that helps ground your experience. Not sure what to expect? We’ll circle up with other identifying women for guided conversation, reflection, and ritual. With Connie’s facilitation, the evening is designed to help you reconnect with yourself and with one another. Expect to leave feeling refreshed, grounded, and supported as you move through the season ahead. Financial Assistance is available. Reach out if you have any questions: info@yogamechanics.com Share this: Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook

item.title: The Unwind - Post Sound Healing Dance Party with @RightontimeTay — Sat Sep 26, 9:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Saturday, September 26 · 9:00 PM · $10 Following the Sonic Sound Healing that starts at 7pm. Tickets for that are sold here. After the sound bath winds down, the night doesn’t have to end — it just changes shape. Come dance it out at The Unwind, a low-pressure, all-are-welcome dance session for anyone who wants to keep moving after the bowls go quiet. This isn’t a club night. There’s no social pressure, set choreography, or a “right” way to move. Think soft lighting, a thoughtfully built playlist, and a room full of people swaying, stepping, and shaking loose whatever the sound healing stirred up. Come as you are — sweatpants, bare feet, eyes closed if you want them closed. Dance alone, dance with a stranger, or just sway in place. All bodies, all skill levels, all moods welcome. It’s the perfect way to integrate a sound healing session, moving what’s been released, letting it settle into the body through motion instead of stillness. item.description:
Tech Toolbox is a free hands-on workshop series focused on building real, practical digital skills. Each session zeroes in on a specific skill, program, or tool—from core computer skills and file management to navigating software and online platforms you use every day. Participants are encouraged to bring their own devices and follow along, so you'll leave each session having actually practiced what you learned.
All experience levels are welcome, and your instructor will be there to walk you through everything step by step. Sessions are free and open to the public.

item.title: Tech Talks — Tue Nov 3, 3:30 PM — Montclair Main - Classroom
item.description:
Tech Talks is a free informational series where library staff introduce and explain the technology topics that matter most in today's digital world. Each session takes a closer look at a new or complex topic—whether it's a trending app, an emerging technology, or a platform you've been hearing about but aren't quite sure how to navigate. Through demonstrations and clear, jargon-free explanations, you'll come away with a better understanding of the tech landscape around you. There's no hands-on component, so no devices are needed—just come ready to learn and ask questions.
All are welcome regardless of experience level, and time is reserved at the end of each session for Q&A. Sessions are free and open to the public.

item.title: Connection Cafe- In person — Sun Dec 6, 11:00 AM — UUCM-1-Fletcher Hall (306)
item.description:
You are invited to join us for our in person Connection Café every Sunday at 11:00 AM. Coffee will be provided. If you haven’t yet experienced our online Connection Café, give it a try. Participants report that this format allows us to build relationships across the congregation in ways that will sustain us as individual participants and support our growth as a community. So grab your coffee and join us for a fun way to connect on Sunday morning. All are welcome. We hope you can join us!
Source: UU Congregation of Montclair

item.title: Theater League of Clifton Announces Auditions for “1776” — Wed Sep 16, 7:00 PM
item.description: The Theater League of Clifton will hold auditions for its upcoming production of “1776” on Tuesday, September 15; Wednesday, September 16; and Thursday, September 17, from 7:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. Callbacks by invitation may also be held Thursday, September 17. Auditions will be held at Living Hope, 303 Maplewood Ave., Clifton, NJ 07013. Performances will be held November 13, 14 and 15 at the Wayne Community Center, 1 Pike Drive, Wayne, NJ. The production will be directed by Maren Sugarman. With music and lyrics by Sherman Edwards and a book by Peter Stone, 1776 dramatizes the struggle within the Second Continental Congress to declare American independence. John Adams, Benjamin Franklin and Thomas Jefferson attempt to persuade a divided Congress to break with England while political, regional and personal conflicts threaten to derail the effort. item.description:

You will be inspired!
